direct_proof_arguments: coprimality of the two free variables gives the complete compensation and exact gauge freedom
polynomial Nambu differentiation identifies the pullback hypersurface Jacobian ideal with one implicit derivative
source units and smaller helper degree force field degree one when the implicit derivative descends
coprime Keller pullbacks remove every rational inverse denominator
a radical target descent gives a cyclic source intermediate field, excluded by retained HW0
a nonconstant implicit derivative gives an actually reached singular divisor by quasi-finiteness, excluding normality and codimension-one local embedding
componentwise saturation descends every factor of that derivative; saturation of the union alone is insufficient
the actual Legendre energy is primitive and yields explicit inverse coordinates when its minimal equation is linear
generic cotangent energy labels are affine in the independent stable variables, and their differences give the exact collision-line product
